title.en: Caring veterinary team with service concerns

text.en: Most pet owners speak highly of the veterinary staff, single out veterinary technician Yadan for going above and beyond, and describe the atmosphere as warm and family-like. Clients value clinicians who explain medical diagnoses in depth. However, critical reviewers accuse the practice of poor professionalism and lack of transparency during difficult consultations.

title.en: Loving handling and lifesaving animal care

text.en: Pet parents frequently note that clinicians and technicians treat animals as if they were their own, providing comforting handling during annual exams and vaccinations. Multiple owners credit the team with saving their pets' lives during critical illnesses and providing compassionate senior care. One reviewer expressed safety concerns, but overall handling is warmly praised.

title.en: Reasonable routine rates with bill disputes

text.en: Several reviewers describe routine fees as very reasonable and fair, particularly for regular checkups, cat vaccinations, and minor procedures. Conversely, dissatisfied clients express frustration over unexpected line items such as add-on scraping fees and accuse the clinic of prioritizing revenue over clear communication when treating acutely ill animals.

q.en: Does E & L Animal Clinic handle urgent medical cases?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the veterinary team successfully stabilized critical emergency conditions and provided intensive care.

q.en: How do reviewers describe the clinic's atmosphere?

a.en: Owners frequently describe the clinic as clean, welcoming, and family-oriented, with friendly staff and an on-site pet parrot.
Yes, clients note smooth and efficient visits for annual checkups, core vaccinations, and routine health evaluations.
